bugs.summary: the pending 'saving' row is removed in a per-call onSuccess, but per-call callbacks only run for the latest mutate call, so when two titles are added before the first save returns the first row is never removed (spinner forever)
bugs.repro: add 'One' and 'Two' quickly while createDoc is slow; both documents are created and appear in the list, but the 'One' saving row stays in pendingRows forever

bugs.summary: a failed save sets errorMessage, but neither submit nor the success callback clears it, so the error banner stays after a later save succeeds
bugs.repro: edit a fund, Save fails with a server error (banner shows); Save again and it succeeds; fund is saved but errorMessage still shows 'Something went wrong'

bugs.summary: deleting a document removes the row but leaves selectedId/selected pointing at the deleted document, so the side panel keeps showing it and its actions hit a 404
bugs.repro: select doc-1, delete it; the list no longer has it but list.selectedId is still 'doc-1' and list.selected is the deleted doc

bugs.summary: open() only builds the draft when none exists (draft ??= ...) and never resets dirty or field errors, so switching to another fund keeps the previous fund's draft; Save then writes fund A's edits onto fund B
bugs.repro: open Alpha, change the name to 'Alpha edited', open Beta; the form still shows 'Alpha edited' and is dirty; Save renames Beta to 'Alpha edited'

bugs.summary: the optimistic star mutates the cached doc in place and keeps a reference to that same array as 'previous', so the rollback on error restores the already-changed data and the star stays on
bugs.repro: setStarred fails on the server; toggleStar(doc); star.state is error but docs[0].starred stays true

bugs.summary: Approve and Send back are offered for every in-review document, including the current user's own, which the server always refuses with 403
bugs.repro: ana opens her own in_review document; the panel offers Approve and Send back; clicking Approve fails with 'You cannot review your own document'

bugs.summary: show() writes the activity response without checking the panel still shows that document, so a slow history request for the previous document overwrites the new document's history
bugs.repro: select A (history request slow), then B (fast); after A's response arrives the panel shows document B with A's history

bugs.summary: busy is cleared only after every archive succeeds (no try/finally), so one refused document leaves the bulk spinner on and the bulk action disabled forever
bugs.repro: bulk archive a draft and an in_review document; the second is refused with 409; archiveMany rejects and panel.busy stays true, canArchiveSelection stays false

decoys.why_correct: per-call callbacks and state updates only for the latest call (isLatest) is the documented React Query behaviour; the creation-time options still run for every call and the promise always settles
the creation-time onSuccess caches the saved fund under the id from the mutation variables, not the currently open fundId, so a save that finishes after switching funds updates the right cache entry

a second fetchQuery for a key with a request in flight returns that request instead of starting another; it ignores the second fetcher, which is fine because both load the same key, and the next call after it settles fetches again
